message: While you were working, main changed: `users.get_user` was moved to `accounts.users.get_user` in commit 35854fe4. Your code uses it at account.py:9. Update the import and calls to use `accounts.users.get_user`, re-run the tests, then finish.

cmd: git fetch -q 2>&1 | tail -2; git cat-file -t 35854fe4 2>&1; git log --oneline -3 main; ls

git stash -u -q && git merge -q origin/main 2>&1 | tail -3; git stash pop -q; sed -i '' 's/^from users import get_user/from accounts.users import get_user/' account.py; cat account.py; python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -5; git status --short
